crossRefs.note: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…

translations.web: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.
translations.bsb: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
translations.kjv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering
translations.asv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt-offering, nor meal-offering; and ye shall pour no drink-offering thereon.
